description: The ENTIRE real-chain tx-extraction path introduced by the round-4 fix is UNTESTED — the round-4 FIND-002 (exclude founder+SHARED wallets), FIND-003 (exact finalized record-earn window) and FIND-004 (cover the real, non-injected path) remediations are verified only by code-reading, not by any executable test. Concretely: (1) settle-tx.mjs `representativeExternalTx` success branch (lines 41-59) — the log-array iteration, topic0/recipient re-verification, the payer-exclude filter `exclude.has(payer)` (line 56), and `return { tx, from }` — is never executed by any test. (2) The two 'real path' tests in __tests__/settle.test.mjs:41-54 BOTH set `BASE_RPC_URL: 'http://127.0.0.1:1'` (unreachable), so `representativeExternalTx` only ever reaches its catch/return-null branch (settle-tx.mjs:37-38,46). The positive branch that actually produces a real on-chain receipt is never run. (3) The round-4 FIND-002 fix — settle-write.mjs:16 SHARED + :41 passing `myWallets: SHARED` so settle-tx excludes founder+SHARED — has NO test that feeds a SHARED-wallet Transfer log and asserts it is skipped while a genuinely-external Transfer is returned. A regression that dropped the lowercase, the exclude set, or the SHARED list would let an INTERNAL self-transfer be returned as the 'representative external tx', yet every test in the suite would still pass (this is precisely the 'a test that passes even if the critical edge case is unhandled' failure mode). (4) settle-write.mjs:26-34 `recordEarnRange` (the FIND-003 window read of from_block/to_block from the founder ledger) and its finalized-head fallback are likewise unexercised — no test writes a founder-ledger row with from_block/to_block and asserts settle-tx scans exactly that window. There is no skills/earn/gig/__tests__/settle-tx*.test.mjs at all (Glob confirms), and a grep of __tests__/ for representativeExternalTx|recordEarnRange|getLogs returns zero matches. NOTE: the SUPREME no-fabrication invariant still holds independently of this gap — the AMOUNT comes only from record-earn's chain scan (run.sh:130 VERIFIED parse → settle-write.mjs:18-22), and a broken settle-tx filter would only attach an inaccurate representative tx hash to an already-real external earn, never invent USDC — which is why this is MAJOR, not critical. REQUIRED FIX: add a settle-tx.mjs unit test that drives `representativeExternalTx` with an injected eth_getLogs result (seam parallel to record-earn's FOUNDER_RAW_LOGS_JSON, e.g. accept a logs array or stub `fetch`/RPC) asserting (a) a genuine external Transfer log → returns its transactionHash, (b) a Transfer FROM a SHARED wallet (0xa3cd.../0x9b1e...) and FROM the founder wallet are EXCLUDED (returns null when only those exist), and (c) when {fromBlock,toBlock} from recordEarnRange are present they are used verbatim, else the finalized-head fallback is used.

evidence.snippet: runSettleWrite(50, { GIG_SETTLE_TX: ..., BASE_RPC_URL: 'http://127.0.0.1:1' }); // unreachable RPC => representativeExternalTx only ever hits its return-null catch; the positive log-parse + founder/SHARED exclude branch (settle-tx.mjs:41-59) is never executed by ANY test
